{{Quote|--And though the enemy brought great numbers to the field of battle, for every number, there is a negative. Their strength became my own. Their minds became my own. All flesh is my flesh. None move, save I will it.<br />This is the rule the Sith were promised, and I have made it real!|from [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]'s translation of the codex of [[Karness Muur]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 28">[[Knights of the Old Republic 28|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 28]]</ref>}}
The '''codex of Karness Muur''' was an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] document, presumably authored by [[Karness Muur]], one of the first [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. It was translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]] by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] sometime prior to his death in [[4400 BBY]], and likely before his exile of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].
